questions.question: On 30 May 2025, which state declared 100% literacy under the ULLAS Nav Bharat Literacy Programme, surpassing its earlier PLFS-recorded rate?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa** declared **100% literacy** under the **ULLAS Nav Bharat Literacy Programme** on **30 May 2025**.
 
• The state achieved this milestone by surpassing its earlier **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)-recorded literacy rate**.
 
• The **ULLAS Nav Bharat Literacy Programme** is a nationwide scheme aimed at enhancing literacy levels across India.
 
• Goa’s efforts in literacy can be attributed to its strong focus on **education policies**, **community engagement**, and efficient implementation of the programme.
 
• The state has consistently been among the best-performing states in terms of **human development indices**, including education.
 
• The declaration aligns with **Goa’s vision** to provide inclusive and accessible education to all citizens, fostering socio-economic development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kerala**__

 __
 
• **Kerala** is renowned for its **high literacy rate** and has been a model state in terms of educational achievements in India.
 
• The state’s literacy rate has consistently been among the highest in India due to its emphasis on **education policies** and **social welfare programmes**.
 
• Kerala was the first state in India to achieve **100% primary education**.
 
 
 
• **Himachal**__
 __
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** has made significant progress in literacy and education, particularly in rural areas.
 
• The state focuses on initiatives like **inclusive education programmes**, especially for marginalized groups.
 
• Himachal Pradesh has achieved notable success in reducing the **gender gap in literacy**.
 
 
 
• **Sikkim**__
 
 
• **Sikkim** is one of the smaller states in India, known for its efforts to enhance literacy and education.
 
• The state has implemented several programmes aimed at promoting **education in remote and tribal areas**.
 
• Sikkim’s literacy drive is complemented by its focus on **environmental education** and sustainable practices.

questions.question: In 2025, which state launched a groundbreaking initiative aimed at eradicating mother to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis, and Hepatitis B by 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In 2025, the state of **West Bengal** launched an innovative program aimed at eradicating mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis, and Hepatitis B by the year 2026.
 
• This initiative aligns with global efforts under the **World Health Organization’s (WHO) elimination strategy** for these diseases.
 
• West Bengal became the **first state in India** to implement such a comprehensive program focusing on maternal and child health.
 
• The program includes widespread testing, awareness campaigns, and free treatment for affected mothers to ensure the health of newborns.
 
• Specialized healthcare facilities were set up in collaboration with national and international health organizations to support this initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mother-to-Child Transmission (MTCT):**

 
 
• MTCT refers to the transmission of diseases such as HIV, syphilis, or Hepatitis B from an infected mother to her child during pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding.
 
• It is a major public health issue, especially in low- and middle-income countries.
 
 
 
• **HIV Elimination Efforts:**
 
 
• The **UNAIDS 95-95-95 targets** aim to ensure that 95% of people with HIV know their status, 95% are on treatment, and 95% achieve viral suppression by 2030.
 
• India has been actively working to reduce HIV prevalence through initiatives like the National AIDS Control Program.
 
 
 
• **Syphilis Testing and Treatment:**
 
 
• Early detection and treatment of syphilis during pregnancy can prevent congenital syphilis, which can lead to severe complications in newborns.
 
• Penicillin remains the most effective treatment for syphilis.
 
 
 
• **Hepatitis B Prevention:**
 
 
• Hepatitis B vaccines are highly effective in preventing transmission and are recommended for all newborns within 24 hours of birth.
 
• India’s Universal Immunization Program includes free Hepatitis B vaccination for children.

questions.question: Which state is set to receive its first Integrated Aqua Park under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana, laid virtually by PM Narendra Modi?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PM Narendra Modi virtually laid the foundation stone for the first Integrated Aqua Park in Nagaland, at Tzudikong in Mokokchung district.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Aqua Park will serve as a hub for fisheries-related development and will be the first of its kind in Nagaland.
 
• It will focus on **fish and seed production** and act as a comprehensive resource centre for the fisheries sector.
 
• The facility aims to provide **market linkages, quality inputs, and equitable pricing** for fishery products.
 
• It will create **new livelihood opportunities**, empower educated unemployed youth, and promote sustainable growth in fisheries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Integrated Aqua Park**__: A comprehensive facility aimed at enhancing fish production, seed quality, and overall development in the fisheries sector.
 
• __**Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)**__: A flagship central government scheme to promote fisheries, ensure sustainable growth, and boost livelihoods.
 
• __**Livelihood opportunities**__: Employment avenues generated for youth and local communities through fisheries development activities.
 
• __**Market linkages**__: Systems connecting producers to buyers, ensuring fair prices and improved access to markets for fishery products.

questions.question: The Kartik Naach Festival, one of South Asia’s oldest living performance traditions, was originally instituted by which monarch of Patan in the 17th century?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Siddhinarsingh Malla.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nepal’s historic Kartik Naach Festival concluded on Kartik Purnima at Patan Durbar Square, celebrating its 300-year-old tradition of devotional dance, music, and drama.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kartik Naach Festival** was established in the **17th century** by **King Siddhinarsingh Malla** of Patan as a devotional performance dedicated to Hindu deities.
 
• It is held annually at the **Patan Durbar Square** in Lalitpur, a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• The festival features mythological narratives from the **Ramayana** and **Lord Vishnu’s incarnations** through traditional dance and music.
 
• The performances preserve **centuries-old choreography and musical traditions**, passed down through local artist families.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kartik Naach (Katti Pyakha)**__

 __
 
• Duration: 10 days
 
• Occasion: Concludes on **Kartik Purnima**
 
• Location: **Patan Durbar Square**, Lalitpur, Nepal
 
 
 
• **Patan Durbar Square**__
 __
 
• Listed as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• Showcases **Newar architecture** and cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Musical Elements**__
 __
 
• Instruments used: **Madal**, **Panchai Baja**, and other traditional Nepali instruments.
 
• Music accompanies classical dance performances depicting mythological tales.
 
 
 
• **Modern Additions**__
 __
 
• Included an international **Painting Exhibition** at the Patan Museum by artists from China, Japan, and Germany.
 
• Proceeds supported **children’s welfare initiatives**, linking art with social responsibility.
 
 
 
• **Tourism and Cultural Impact**__
 
 
• Boosts **local tourism** and preserves **intangible heritage**.
 
• Encourages **youth participation** and global cultural exchange.

questions.question: Why are Palmyra palm trees being promoted in Odisha?

options.text: As a natural safeguard against lightning strikes
To provide shade in urban areas

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**As a natural safeguard against lightning strikes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Odisha Promotes Palmyra Palm as Natural Safeguard to Lightning Strikes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Odisha** ranks among the top states in **lightning-related deaths** (based on **IMD** & **NCRB** data).

 
 
• 
 
**Palmyra palm trees** (scientific name **Borassus flabellifer**) are being promoted as a **natural safeguard** to prevent **lightning strikes**.

 
 
• 
 
**Origin & Status**: Found in tropical regions of **South** and **Southeast Asia**, the **Palmyra palm** is declared the **State Tree of Tamil Nadu**.

 
 
• 
 
**Geographical Requirements**: Highly adaptable, it grows in **sandy, red, black, alluvial**, and **arid soils** and can withstand **semi-arid regions** with less than **750 mm** of annual rainfall.

 
 
• 
 
The **Palmyra palm** can live up to **100 years or more**.

 
 
• 
 
**Utility**:

 
 
• 
 
**Edible fruits**: Used for making **toddy**, **palm sugar**, **jaggery**, and **palm fruit jelly**.

 
 
• 
 
**Leaves**: Used for **thatching**, **mats**, and **writing material** in ancient times.

 
 
• 
 
**Deep roots**: Prevent **soil erosion**, aid in **groundwater recharge**, and provide **fodder** and **shade** in arid regions.
